title: Carved Melon
description: Carve melons with shears to create directional carved melons.
body:
Carved Melons allows players to carve melons using shears.

Right-click a melon with shears to turn it into a carved melon block with a face. The face will point toward the player when carved.

Carving the melon drops melon slices.

The carved melon behaves like a normal block and appears in the Natural Blocks creative tab after melon.
